verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own Public API is documented as letting organizations manage policies, which confirms that org-level policies exist and that admins can administer them. Nothing in the evidence names the specific policies in the story (app lock or timeout, export restriction, master password strength) or shows how they are enforced on members' clients. missing for 10: documentation of specific policy types (vault timeout/app lock, disable personal export, master password requirements), evidence of enforcement across every member's apps, an admin-console policy UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
